parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, signing off on them before they leave. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I am the licensed person responsible for deciding which drone flies and along which way. Drones fly on their own autopilots along corridors between named sites, and I can call off a flight if needed. While things happen outside our control and nobody watches every drone at every moment, I have to handle jobs like deliveries, which carry a load from one site to another, and inspections, which take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where it started.
